question: How many appointments do we have booked each month in 2029? Definition: Appointments (any final status) by slot month (YYYY-MM), 2029. Appointments: each appointment_id once, in its latest delivered version, from the appointments feed (both the population and deep-chart schemas); slot date = slot_start, else scheduled_time/scheduled_date, else the record's event date (some deep-chart appointment rows carry only that); attended and arrived count as fulfilled, rescheduled as cancelled. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many members were on an SSRI in 2028? Definition: Persons with >= 1 SSRI fill in 2028. Fills = paid payer pharmacy claims not reversed or recouped (a superseded claim version is replaced by its later version); drug class from NDC/RxNorm (drug catalog) or ingredient name. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

Which patients look like they have kidney disease from their eGFR but aren't diagnosed? Definition: Persons with two delivered eGFR results < 60 at least 90 days apart and no documented CKD code (N18). Documented = ICD-10 code on a paid payer claim, an EHR problem-list entry or an EHR encounter diagnosis, any date through as_of. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many duplicate patient charts are in the data? Definition: Duplicate charts present in the (sampled) warehouse: patient_ids that belong to the same person as another chart. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many ER visits did our members have in 2028? Definition: ED visits with service date in 2028. ED visit = distinct person and service date with a non-voided payer claim for an ED service (professional place of service 23, or an institutional line with revenue code 045x). Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

What percent of diabetics 40-75 filled a statin in 2029? Definition: SPD: persons 40-75 with diabetes documented by 2029-12-31 and a primary span in 2029; met if >= 1 paid statin fill in 2029. Percent. Documented = ICD-10 code on a paid payer claim, an EHR problem-list entry or an EHR encounter diagnosis, any date through as_of. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.
How many claims were voided in 2029? Definition: All patients. Payer claims with a frequency-8 (void) adjudication dated 2029. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How long after a diabetes diagnosis do patients start metformin? Definition: Persons whose first documented E11 code is on or after 2027-03-01 (180 days into the data): median days from it to the first metformin fill on or after it. Documented = ICD-10 code on a paid payer claim, an EHR problem-list entry or an EHR encounter diagnosis, any date through as_of. Fills = paid payer pharmacy claims not reversed or recouped (a superseded claim version is replaced by its later version); drug class from NDC/RxNorm (drug catalog) or ingredient name. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.
How many pharmacy claims were rejected in 2028, and why? Definition: All patients. Rejected payer pharmacy claims with fill date in 2028 by NCPDP reject code. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many member-months did we have in 2028 by line of business? Definition: Member-months in 2028 (covered on the 1st, through death) by product, all delivered spans including secondary products; a span version superseded by a later delivered version (retro-termination, correction) is replaced by it, and each person counts once per month per product. Table keys are the delivered product values. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.
